evidence: The elemental composition and valence band (VB) spectra were determined by x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) using a Thermo Scientiﬁc KA1066 spectrometer. Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS) and elastic recoil detection (ERD) measurements with a 1.9 MeV Heþ beam source were conducted to determine the composition and the mass density of the ﬁlms. Grazing incidence x-ray diffraction (GI-XRD) measurements were performed to study the crystallinity of the ﬁlm. The ﬁlm growth was monitored in situ using a J.A. Woollam Co., Inc., M2000U rotating compensator spectroscopic ellipsometer (SE). XPS VB studies were performed on both the thermal ALD and the PE-ALD deposited ﬁlms to further conﬁrm oxygen vacancies observed in the ﬁlms.
